title: Retain indexed-key sorting after caller-wide ordering audit

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Audit every canonical production caller of TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed after GPU-81. Determine whether caller-wide deterministic row-major insertion is already guaranteed strongly enough to delete sorted(entries) inside the existing indexed CSR owner. Do not add an ordered-map flag, helper, backend, cache, second constructor or alternate graph authority merely to avoid sorting.

canonical_owner.current_behavior: _from_indexed validates every indexed row/column key before materializing ordered = sorted(entries), then fills canonical row-major CSR from the validated sorted keys while reading values from the original bounded mapping.

production_callers.finding: coordinates is an externally supplied bounded Sequence and is consumed in caller-provided order. The entries dict therefore inherits first-seen coordinate insertion order, including arbitrary valid permutations and duplicate-coordinate update order. Axis labels are canonical, but coordinate input order is not. Removing sorted(entries) would make the emitted CSR depend on input sequence order.

The compiler inserts selected semantic coordinates into per-signature dict buckets. Same-plane Forest edges originate from KnowledgeForest edge order, but verified cross-plane bindings originate from FourfoldSnapshot.bindings. FourfoldSnapshot canonicalizes bindings by binding digest, not by (source_index, target_index), so cross-plane coordinate insertion is deterministic yet not row-major. Evidence-dag value conversion mutates values in place and does not reorder keys.

eliminated_former_caller.finding: The historical Boolean projection module no longer calls _from_indexed directly; it delegates to compile_relation_blocks and therefore creates no independent ordering guarantee.

forest.finding: build_knowledge_forest sorts edges by (relation, source, target, directed, weight). That is deterministic source evidence ordering, but it cannot establish a caller-wide _from_indexed contract because from_coordinates is arbitrary-order and cross-plane bindings use a different canonical order.

fourfold_bindings.finding: FourfoldSnapshot validates binding semantics and then sorts unique bindings by binding digest. Digest ordering is intentionally canonical evidence ordering, not sparse row-major coordinate ordering.

audit.conclusion: No existing caller-wide row-major insertion guarantee exists. sorted(entries) is therefore the minimal shared deterministic canonicalization boundary in TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed and must remain. Encoding an ordering promise in a flag or second constructor would move complexity outward and create parallel admission semantics without eliminating a proven requirement.

semantic_invariants.canonical_order: Every accepted indexed mapping remains canonicalized to deterministic lexicographic (row, column) order in the single TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed owner.
semantic_invariants.from_coordinates: Equivalent coordinate multisets remain independent of caller sequence order after semiring aggregation.
semantic_invariants.compiler: Forest/Fourfold evidence order remains an authority/evidence concern and is not silently redefined as CSR storage order.
semantic_invariants.error_precedence: GPU-81 key validation before sorting remains unchanged.
semantic_invariants.source_of_truth: KnowledgeForest and FourfoldSnapshot remain authoritative; TypedRelationBlock remains a regenerable computational view.
semantic_invariants.public_api: No public API or compatibility facade changes in this packet.

result.summary: The remaining sorted(entries) key transient is required by current semantics. from_coordinates accepts arbitrary coordinate sequence order, and compile_relation_blocks receives verified cross-plane bindings in digest order rather than row-major coordinate order. Deleting sorting now would trade one bounded transient for order-dependent CSR output or require a new parallel ordering contract, so the Gardener result is to retain the single canonical sort and stop this deletion path.

verification.kind: read-only caller/contract audit plus exact branch evidence record
verification.notes: This packet makes no executable change and therefore does not claim a new test or benchmark result. Its acceptance evidence is the explicit source/contract audit showing that at least two accepted construction paths do not share a row-major insertion guarantee.

Prefer a small in-owner fast path only if it preserves direct-construction validation, duplicate-name refusal, block-subject/semiring/signature checks and deterministic block-name ordering; otherwise retain the current boundary. Do not add a receipt registry, alternate collection type or second compiler.
